name: MakerWorks-v2-Worker
description: Companion background worker for MakerWorks v2. This container consumes BullMQ image and model-preview jobs queued by the MakerWorks web app. Install MakerWorks Redis before starting this worker.

paths.name: Storage Path
paths.description: Persistent MakerWorks storage. Must match the MakerWorks-v2 web container mapping.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Must match MakerWorks-v2.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Redis connection string used for BullMQ processing queues.

variables.name: Queue Backoff Milliseconds
variables.description: Exponential retry backoff delay in milliseconds.

variables.name: Image Worker Concurrency
variables.description: Parallel image-processing jobs consumed by this worker.

variables.name: Preview Worker Concurrency
variables.description: Parallel model-preview jobs consumed by this worker.
